mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fitness_center ( member_id, type, center_name, center_phone, oper_time, facility_addr, facility_addr_detail, facility_amenities, homepage_url, description, day_pass_yn, month_cost, day_cost, sns_link1, sns_link2, addon, lat, `long`, approve_status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{type}, #{centerName}, #{centerPhone}, #{operTime}, #{facilityAddr}, #{facilityAddrDetail}, #{facilityAmenities}, #{homepageUrl}, #{description}, #{dayPassYn}, #{monthCost}, #{dayCost}, #{sns_link1}, #{snsLink2}, #{addon}, #{lat}, #{lon}, 0 )

INSERT INTO center_ticket (center_no, ticket_name, ticket_price, discount_price, period_months) VALUES
(#{item.centerNo}, #{item.ticketName}, #{item.ticketPrice}, #{item.discountPrice}, #{item.periodMonths})
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_no AS ticketNo, center_no AS centerNo, ticket_name AS ticketName, ticket_price AS ticketPrice, discount_price AS discountPrice, period_months AS periodMonths FROM center_ticket WHERE center_no = #{centerNo} ORDER BY ticket_price ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.center_no as centerNo, c.member_id as memberId, c.type, c.center_name as centerName, c.center_phone as centerPhone, c.oper_time as operTime, c.facility_addr as facilityAddr, c.facility_addr_detail as facilityAddrDetail, c.facility_amenities as facilityAmenities, c.homepage_url as homepageUrl, c.description, c.review_score as reviewScore, c.day_pass_yn as dayPassYn, c.month_cost as monthCost, c.day_cost as dayCost, c.sns_link1 as snsLink1, c.sns_link2 as snsLink2, c.addon, c.lat, c.`long` as lon, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE center_no = c.center_no) as reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fitness_like WHERE center_no = c.center_no) as recommendCount, (CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM advertisement a WHERE a.center_no = c.center_no AND a.ad_status = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isAd,
(IFNULL((SELECT 100 FROM advertisement a WHERE a.center_no = c.center_no AND a.ad_status = 1 AND a.ad_type = '상위노출형' AND NOW() BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date AND REPLACE(IFNULL(a.target_keyword, ''), ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', ''), '%') LIMIT 1), 0) + (CASE WHEN REPLACE(c.facility_addr, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', ''), '%') THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN REPLACE(c.center_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', ''), '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END)) as matchScore
IFNULL((SELECT 100 FROM advertisement a WHERE a.center_no = c.center_no AND a.ad_status = 1 AND a.ad_type = '상위노출형' AND NOW() BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date LIMIT 1), 0) as matchScore
FROM fitness_center c LEFT JOIN fitness_center_working_hours w ON c.center_no = w.center_no WHERE c.approve_status = 1 AND c.type = #{type} AND c.day_pass_yn = 1 AND w.is_24h = 1 ) AS ranking_table matchScore > 0 ORDER BY matchScore DESC, centerNo DESC

SELECT c.*, c.`long` as lon, w.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE center_no = c.center_no) as reviewCount FROM fitness_center c LEFT JOIN fitness_center_working_hours w ON c.center_no = w.center_no WHERE c.center_no = #{centerNo}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (center_no, member_id, content, review_score, created_date) VALUES (#{centerNo}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{rating}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_like WHERE review_id = r.review_id) as recommendCount FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.member_id = u.member_id WHERE r.center_no = #{centerNo} ORDER BY recommendCount DESC, r.created_date DESC LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE fitness_center SET review_score = (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(review_score), 1), 0) FROM review WHERE center_no = #{centerNo}) WHERE center_no = #{centerNo}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, a.ad_title as adTitle, a.ad_content as adContent FROM advertisement a JOIN fitness_center c ON a.center_no = c.center_no WHERE a.ad_type = '배너형' AND a.ad_status = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 3
